brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability given pre-exposure Z, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the population causal effect by standardization. Population Z weights are 0.4 and 0.6; stratum risk differences are −0.1 and 0.3. Thus the average causal risk difference is 0.4(−0.1) + 0.6(0.3) = 0.14.
